manualChecks.detail: Original teaching material uses SE=H0/H1 as a linear amplitude ratio; webpage separately shows SEdB=20log10(H0/H1).
uoc=-M di/dt is an ideal open-circuit induced emf; a calibrated loaded current probe uses frequency-dependent transfer impedance ZT(f).
ESR+ESL+C is an approximate model. Do not treat typical clock-dependent decoupling ranges in old slide deck as universal component-selection standards.
2V+ is the first open-end voltage relative to the incident travelling wave; source amplitude and source reflection must be tracked independently.
